summary: All 7 phases COMPLETED. Shipped scripts/census-count.sh (occurrences/membership/cross-check subcommands, each mapping to one of the three named bug classes plus the cross-check discipline, each emitting a greppable record block with the verbatim producing command), scripts/tests/test-census-count.sh (8 cases, all three bug classes with naive-vs-correct assertions), scripts/tests/test-validate-no-task-references.sh (21 cases), context/standards/shell-script-testing.md, context/standards/census-methodology.md. Fixed hooks/validate-no-task-references.sh's separator-only regex gap (task-N/task_N/Task #N were invisible) plus a task-qualified compound Phase branch, with a confirmed mutation check (revert-then-restore). Registered 3 new provides.scripts entries and 2 new index-entries.json entries in agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json and index-entries.json. Every edit targets agent-system/extensions/core/**; git status --short confirms zero .claude/** paths. Both test suites exit 0 (21/21, 8/8) from a clean shell. Three registration validators (validate-extension-index.sh, validate-context-index.sh, check-extension-docs.sh) all PASSED; validate-context-index.sh inspects the deployed .claude/context/index.json only and does not see this task's new entries -- reported as an expected stale-deploy discrepancy, not fixed (redeploy out of scope).
decisions_made: D1: Ship both tooling and a documented method -- a prose-only deliverable cannot satisfy the binding testedness constraint.

D2: Harness location is agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/, a core-local convention (provides.scripts already carries subdirectory-qualified lint/ paths), matching literature's own scope-based split.

D3: Helper naming inside core tests is pass()/fail()/info() with PASSED/FAILED counters, following test-task-lock-reap.sh's precedent. test-task-lock-reap.sh is NOT migrated (recorded as a tolerated exception).
D4: Fixtures built inline via heredocs into a mktemp -d root; no committed fixture tree.
D5: Phase references in the hook's remit ONLY in the task-qualified compound form (task N phase P / phase P of task N). A bare 'Phase N' stays out of remit to avoid alert fatigue.
D6: Method doc lives at context/standards/census-methodology.md (indexed, load_when-scoped), not rules/.

Phase 1 confirmed (not assumed): manifest.json's provides.context lists directory names only ('standards' already present); no manifest edit needed for the two new context/standards/*.md files, only index-entries.json entries.

Shipped separator group: TASK_SEP='([[:space:]]+#?|[-_#])' -- explicit alternation, never a bracket class containing '-'. Validated via the Phase 3 fixture suite plus a one-time mutation check (reverted to '[[:space:]]+', suite dropped to 17/21, restored to 21/21).

Phase 7 correction to Phase 2's file: the fixed hook was flagging its own explanatory comments (which used a concrete example digit '788'). Rewrote those comments to use letter placeholders (N, P, M); no behavior change, re-verified clean.

Deviation: the plan estimated a naive whitespace-only pattern would miss 'four of the five' named separator forms in the census-count.sh bug-class-3 fixture; verified directly it misses 3 of 5 (only 2 forms contain literal whitespace). Test asserts the verified 5-vs-2 result; the underlying naive-vs-correct proof point is unchanged.
Real-repo dogfooding (membership: manifest provides.scripts vs scripts/*.sh on disk) appears ONLY as a worked example in the method doc, never as a test assertion.
